newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei holds gains, hovers below 21,000.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei holds gains, hovers below 21,000.

text.p: Tokyo stocks clung on to their gains in mid-afternoon trade on Thursday, with the main market index hovering below the key 21,000 point.

Institutional investors bought actively following Wednesday's "tankan" quarterly survey by the Bank of Japan, which showed big manufacturers in surprisingly upbeat mood. But strong profit-taking interest capped the upside, brokers said.
At 0451 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was up 138.31 points or 0.67 percent at 20,817.58. It had hovered between 20,714.67 and 20,910.79.
Its September futures stood 60 points higher at 20,820.
